shop.name: Nilgiri Post
shop.tagline: Single-estate tea and coffee, shipped from the hills.

policies.returns: Unopened packs may be returned within 7 days of delivery. Return shipping is paid by the customer unless the item arrived damaged. Brewing equipment is non-returnable once used.
policies.shipping: Dispatched within 2 working days from Coonoor. Delivery typically 3-6 working days depending on pincode.
policies.cod: Cash on delivery available on orders under 3000 INR for serviceable pincodes.

products.title: Nilgiri Frost Green Tea
products.description: Hand-plucked during the frost season in the Nilgiris, when the leaf sugars concentrate. Bright, faintly sweet, with a clean finish. Brews pale gold. Best at 80C for two minutes.

products.title: Araku Valley Filter Coffee
products.description: Arabica grown at 900m by cooperatives in the Araku Valley, roasted medium-dark and ground for the South Indian filter. Chicory-free. Chocolate and dried fig, low acidity.

products.title: Masala Chai Blend
products.description: Strong Assam CTC cut with green cardamom, ginger, clove and a little black pepper. Made to stand up to milk and a long boil. The house blend, and the one people reorder.

products.title: Single Estate Assam CTC
products.description: Second flush CTC from one garden in Upper Assam. Malty, brisk and dark in the cup. Built for chai rather than for drinking plain.

products.title: Cardamom Green Tea
products.description: Nilgiri green leaf scented with crushed Idukki cardamom. Lighter than a masala chai and drunk without milk. Good in the evening.

products.title: Cold Brew Concentrate
products.description: Araku arabica steeped 18 hours and bottled at 4x strength. Dilute one part to three. Keeps two weeks refrigerated. Made in small batches, so it goes in and out of stock.

products.title: Copper Chai Kettle
products.description: Hand-beaten copper with a tin lining, 1.2 litres. Made by a workshop in Moradabad. Heats fast and unevenly, which is the point for chai.

products.title: Ceramic Cupping Set
products.description: Five stoneware cupping bowls and a lidded brewing cup, glazed matte white. What we use on the table when deciding what to buy.
